title: Accenture Caps Central Claude Funding at $29 per Person Monthly
summary:
Employees at Accenture must now secure project-specific budget approval to maintain their access to the Claude AI tool if they exceed a new corporate reimbursement limit. Central funding for Claude Enterprise usage is now capped at $29 per person per month, according to an internal announcement obtained by 404 Media. This change impacts power users who previously spent between $500 and $1,000 monthly, including some using Claude Code to build accelerators for clients. While some premium accounts still receive $250 in weekly token usage, other staff have already had their access revoked.

The budget restriction comes after Accenture and Anthropic announced a partnership to train 30,000 professionals on the AI platform. That rollout included plans to make Claude Code available to tens of thousands of developers to automate technical workflows. High-usage employees are now required to find funding from specific projects or team budgets to cover costs exceeding the new monthly allowance.
